# Security analysis profile fixtures

`a/output/` and `b/output/` are the control, scope-exclusion and SpecReview artifacts emitted by live `codex exec` runs following `skills/spec-security-analysis/SKILL.md` on 2026-11-14. The two synthetic `.ix/source-profile.yaml` inputs select `web-app-baseline` and `owasp-only`, respectively. `skill-run-state.json` records the exact selection bytes and evaluated context immediately before and after each live run; `TC-008` asserts both snapshots are unchanged. The outputs contain only synthetic set keys and clause identifiers; no source corpus or vendored clause text is included.

`tests/scripts/run_security_profile_skill_fixtures.sh` reproduces both live runs and refreshes their snapshots and artifacts. It requires `IX_HOME`, `IX_FILAMENT_MODULES_PATH`, `QUOIN_SEMANTIC_ROOT`, and `QUOIN_ORG` to point to the installed synthetic profile and authoring modules. `tc_171_profile_mappings.rs` evaluates equivalent synthetic profile definitions at test time, parses every mapping from the emitted artifacts, and checks each against the evaluation report. The tests assert that non-binding, unresolved and out-of-profile mappings are absent, and that unresolved findings name missing context dimensions.
